title: Here's why Shedeur Sanders was paid a record $17.7 million by NFLPA

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Here's why Shedeur Sanders was paid a record $17.7 million by NFLPA
sources.description: Shedeur Sanders' rookie contract is worth just under $4.65 million, but he made nearly quadruple that from the NFLPA over the last year. Here's why.
